SELECT t.turns_remaining FROM turns t JOIN players p ON p.player_id=t.player_id WHERE p.name='transwarp_poor'

tests.name: Poor player receives transwarp toll offer
Insufficient-funds rollback preserves offer, credits, turns, sector and fuel

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.sector_id=1 AND p.credits=0 AND t.turns_remaining=@{poor_turns_before} AND c.quantity=30 AND o.state='pending' AND (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='toll_collector')=1000000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN turns t ON t.player_id=p.player_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' JOIN toll_passage_offers o ON o.player_id=p.player_id AND o.offer_id='@{poor_toll_offer}' WHERE p.name='transwarp_poor'

tests.name: Provide exact toll amount for retry

data.sql: UPDATE players SET credits=3 WHERE name='transwarp_poor'

tests.name: Insufficient-funds offer settles once after retry

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.sector_id=10 AND p.credits=0 AND c.quantity=27 AND o.state='accepted' AND (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='toll_collector')=1000000003 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=p.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' JOIN toll_passage_offers o ON o.player_id=p.player_id AND o.offer_id='@{poor_toll_offer}' WHERE p.name='transwarp_poor'

Refusal records no payment and applies combat damage exactly once

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.sector_id=10 AND p.credits=5000 AND c.quantity=27 AND s.shields=90 AND o.state='refused' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sector_assets a WHERE a.sector_id=10 AND a.owner_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='toll_collector') AND a.offensive_setting=3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=p.ship_id JOIN ship_cargo c ON c.ship_id=s.ship_id AND c.commodity_code='ORE' JOIN toll_passage_offers o ON o.player_id=p.player_id AND o.offer_id='@{refusal_offer}' WHERE p.name='transwarp_refuser'
